posts.title: Vegan Rose-Infused Bounty Bars
posts.description: Created by renowned food photographer and blogger Murielle Banackissa , these homemade bars have a beautiful pink hue and floral aroma.

posts.title: Stuffed Plant-Based Muffaletta Sandwich
posts.description: Take a tasty trip to New Orleans with this sensational, super-savory sandwich. For extra authenticity, layer this massive meal up with your favorite vegan meats and cheeses—just make sure to leave room for beignets!

posts.title: Easy Cashew Vanilla Bean Eggnog
posts.description: Okay, we know this recipe seems a little on the light side, but trust us: one sip of this splendid libation and you'll forget that the word "nog" was ever preceded by the word "egg."
